name: Review camera coverage report
title: Review camera coverage report
description: Check camera status, type, area, and coordinate coverage. Use filters that match your operational scope, then follow up on cameras with missing or ambiguous locations. Coverage is only as good as the inventory and boundary sources supplied.
report_description: Review the spatial and status coverage of registered cameras. Filter to the intended area, compare located versus unlocated records, and investigate duplicates or stale/inactive devices before interpreting gaps as real coverage gaps.
